description: This file contains test functions for verifying the behavior of FastAPI's OpenAPI documentation HTML generators, specifically get_swagger_ui_html and get_redoc_html. The tests check for correct inclusion of URLs and customization options in the generated HTML content.

methods.name: test_strings_in_generated_swagger()
methods.description: Tests that the default Swagger UI HTML includes the correct URLs for JS, CSS, and favicon.

methods.name: test_strings_in_custom_swagger()
methods.description: Tests that custom URLs for JS, CSS, and favicon are included in the Swagger UI HTML.

methods.name: test_strings_in_generated_redoc()
methods.description: Verifies that the default Redoc HTML contains the correct URLs for JS and favicon.

methods.name: test_strings_in_custom_redoc()
methods.description: Verifies that custom URLs for Redoc JS and favicon are included in the HTML.

methods.name: test_google_fonts_in_generated_redoc()
methods.description: Checks that Google Fonts are included or excluded in the Redoc HTML based on the with_google_fonts parameter.
